overview_description.description:
Scripbox owns and operates an online investing platform that distributes mutual funds in India. Its platform allows investors to buy and sell equity, debt, and tax saving mutual funds. 

Sanjiv Singhal founded Scripbox in 2012. It has its headquarters in Bengaluru in India.

product.name: Mutual Funds Investment Platform
product.description: A platform offering investment in various mutual funds including regular and direct plans, enabling users to invest in equity, debt, and hybrid funds aligned to their financial goals.

product.name: Financial Planning Services
product.description: Services that help users create personalized financial plans based on their goals, risk tolerance, and investment horizon to guide their wealth creation journey.

product.name: Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) Investment
product.description: A service enabling investment in various ETFs including equity, gold, bond, and sectoral ETFs, providing diversified exposure through stock exchange trading.

product.name: Recurring Deposit Information and Comparison
product.description: Information and comparison tools for recurring deposit schemes offered by various banks and financial institutions, including interest rates and tenure options.
